n = 0
MOD = 10**9 + 7

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    m_input = int(data[0])
    k_input = int(data[1])
    m = m_input
    k = k_input

    digits_list = []
    while m:
        digits_list.append(m % k)
        m //=k

    n = k + 1

    class Mat:
        def __init__(self):
            self.t = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
        def init(self):
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    self.t[i][j] = 1 if i==j else 0
        def multiply(self, b):
            temp = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    for k_ in range(n):
                        temp[i][k_] += self.t[i][j] * b.t[j][k_]
                        temp[i][k_] %= MOD
            self.t = temp

    baseMat = Mat()
    for i in range(k):
        baseMat.t[i][(i+1)%k] = 1
    baseMat.t[k][k] = 1

    identityMat = Mat()
    identityMat.init()

    for i in range(k+1):
        baseMat.t[0][i] = 1
        baseMat.t[i][i] = 1

    dMat = [None]*len(digits_list)
    dMat[0] = identityMat
    dMat[0].multiply(baseMat)

    for i in range(1, len(digits_list)):
        dMat[i] = dMat[i-1]
        for _ in range(k):
            dMat[i].multiply(dMat[i])
        dMat[i].multiply(baseMat)

    answerArr = [1]*(n)

    for idx in range(len(digits_list)-1, -1, -1):
        for _ in range(digits_list[idx]):
            powerArr = [0]*n
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    powerArr[j] += answerArr[i] * dMat[idx].t[i][j]
                powerArr[j] %= MOD
            answerArr = powerArr

    print(answerArr[k])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
